## 2 Motion graphics

### Motion principles

#### Entrances & easing · #2 001–009 · 117–119

| # | Name | What it is | How to ask an AI |
|---|---|---|---|
| [#2-001](https://sadjjk.github.io/motion-prompt-zh/#2-001) | **Pop-in** | Pops into view with a small bounce | Bring the logo in with a pop-in, about 0.4 s, with a slight overshoot. |
| [#2-002](https://sadjjk.github.io/motion-prompt-zh/#2-002) | **Stagger** | Items appear one after another, slightly offset in time | Bring in the five cards with a stagger, 0.08 s apart, left to right. |
| [#2-003](https://sadjjk.github.io/motion-prompt-zh/#2-003) | **Mask reveal** | Text rises into view from behind an invisible edge | Bring the title in with a mask reveal from below, 0.6 s, each line slightly after the one before. |
| [#2-004](https://sadjjk.github.io/motion-prompt-zh/#2-004) | **Easing** | Motion speeds up and slows down instead of moving at one speed | Add easing to this move: ease-out, slowing down as it stops. |
| [#2-005](https://sadjjk.github.io/motion-prompt-zh/#2-005) | **Overshoot** | Goes a little past the target, then settles back | Give the gauge needle an overshoot: about 10% past the target, then back. |
| [#2-006](https://sadjjk.github.io/motion-prompt-zh/#2-006) | **Squash & stretch** | Squashes and stretches so that it feels elastic | Add squash and stretch when the ball lands; keep the squash subtle. |
| [#2-007](https://sadjjk.github.io/motion-prompt-zh/#2-007) | **Anticipation** | Pulls back briefly before moving forward | Add anticipation before the button shoots off to the right: pull back slightly for 0.3 s, squash, then go. |
| [#2-008](https://sadjjk.github.io/motion-prompt-zh/#2-008) | **Follow-through** | Parts keep swinging after the body stops | Give the hair and the flag follow-through after the character stops: they keep swinging for about 0.5 s, then settle. |
| [#2-009](https://sadjjk.github.io/motion-prompt-zh/#2-009) | **Bounce** | Falls and bounces lower until it stops | Drop the ball from the top with a bounce: three bounces, each lower than the last. |
| [#2-117](https://sadjjk.github.io/motion-prompt-zh/#2-117) | **Duration** | How long a move takes from start to finish | Set the panel's open and close duration to 0.3 s, animating only transform and opacity. |
| [#2-118](https://sadjjk.github.io/motion-prompt-zh/#2-118) | **Delay** | The wait before a move starts | Bring the list rows in one by one with a 0.05 s delay between each, animating only transform and opacity. |
| [#2-119](https://sadjjk.github.io/motion-prompt-zh/#2-119) | **Spring animation** | Motion driven by a spring's stiffness and damping, which can overshoot and settle | Open this modal with a spring animation, damping ratio about 0.6 so it overshoots slightly, animating only transform and opacity. |

|---|---|---|---|

### Text animation

#### Letter by letter & layout · #2 019–029 · 113–114 · 120 · 123

| # | Name | What it is | How to ask an AI |

| [#2-096](https://sadjjk.github.io/motion-prompt-zh/#2-096) | **Impact shake** | The whole frame shakes when something lands | Add an impact shake when the headline lands; it should settle within 0.4 s. |
| [#2-097](https://sadjjk.github.io/motion-prompt-zh/#2-097) | **Confetti burst** | Confetti shoots up as the title springs in | Make the word "Congrats" spring in while about 60 pieces of confetti burst up from below, falling in arcs, spinning, and fading over the last 0.5 s. |
| [#2-098](https://sadjjk.github.io/motion-prompt-zh/#2-098) | **Falling petals** | Petals drift down and scatter at the cursor | Fill the background with about 40 falling petals that sway and flip; when the cursor passes, push nearby petals aside and let them drift back to their paths. |
| [#2-099](https://sadjjk.github.io/motion-prompt-zh/#2-099) | **Fireworks** | A firework rises and bursts where you click | On a night sky, launch a firework from the bottom to wherever I click in 0.7 s, bursting into 40 sparks that slow down, fall under gravity and fade. |
| [#2-116](https://sadjjk.github.io/motion-prompt-zh/#2-116) | **Snowfall** | Snowflakes of different sizes and speeds drift down with real depth | Make it snow on the night street in 3 layers: far flakes small and slow, near flakes big blurred bokeh and faster, all swaying side to side as they fall, and make the flakes passing through the street lamp's light glow warm. |

#### Transitions · #2 100–112

| # | Name | What it is | How to ask an AI |
|---|---|---|---|
| [#2-100](https://sadjjk.github.io/motion-prompt-zh/#2-100) | **Mask transition** | The next scene appears inside a growing shape | Go to the next scene with a mask transition: a circle grows from the center in 0.7 s. |
| [#2-101](https://sadjjk.github.io/motion-prompt-zh/#2-101) | **Shape transition** | Shapes cover the screen and uncover the next scene | Change scenes with a shape transition: four diagonal color bands sweep in from the left. |
| [#2-102](https://sadjjk.github.io/motion-prompt-zh/#2-102) | **Liquid transition** | Liquid flows in and replaces the scene | Use a liquid transition here: blue ink drips down from the top and fills the frame. |
| [#2-103](https://sadjjk.github.io/motion-prompt-zh/#2-103) | **Zoom through** | Zooms into an object and passes through it into the next scene | Zoom through the hole of the "O" in the logo into the next scene, 0.6 s, accelerating. |
| [#2-104](https://sadjjk.github.io/motion-prompt-zh/#2-104) | **Flip** | Turns over like a card to show the other side | Flip the pricing card to show the details on its back, in 0.5 s. |
| [#2-105](https://sadjjk.github.io/motion-prompt-zh/#2-105) | **Push transition** | The next scene pushes the current one out | Go to the next slide with a push transition from the right, 0.8 s. |
| [#2-106](https://sadjjk.github.io/motion-prompt-zh/#2-106) | **Blinds transition** | The next scene opens through thin strips | Change scenes with a blinds transition: seven horizontal strips that open over 1 s. |
| [#2-107](https://sadjjk.github.io/motion-prompt-zh/#2-107) | **Cube transition** | Changes scenes like a turning cube | Switch the product shots with a cube transition, turning 90° to the left in 0.8 s. |
| [#2-108](https://sadjjk.github.io/motion-prompt-zh/#2-108) | **Page curl** | Peels back like paper to show the next page | Go to the next chapter with a page curl from the bottom-right corner, 1.2 s. |
| [#2-109](https://sadjjk.github.io/motion-prompt-zh/#2-109) | **Pixelate** | Turns into coarse blocks, then switches | Use a pixelate transition: the mosaic gets coarser over 0.6 s and the scene changes at the coarsest point. |
| [#2-110](https://sadjjk.github.io/motion-prompt-zh/#2-110) | **Shatter** | Breaks like glass and the shards fly off | Before the title appears, break the previous scene with a shatter: cracks first, then the shards fall away in about 1 s. |
| [#2-111](https://sadjjk.github.io/motion-prompt-zh/#2-111) | **Split screen** | Divides the frame to show scenes side by side | Show three scenes at once with a split screen: from one panel to two, then three, 0.5 s each. |
| [#2-112](https://sadjjk.github.io/motion-prompt-zh/#2-112) | **Burn transition** | A hole burns through the middle of the frame and its charred edge spreads to reveal the next shot | Switch from the city night view to the mountains with a burn transition: a hole burns open in the middle, its irregular charred edge spreads past the frame over 1.3 s, with a glowing orange fire line and a few sparks on the edge. |

## 3 Editing & photography

### Camera & editing

#### Camera movement · #3 001–008

| # | Name | What it is | How to ask an AI |
|---|---|---|---|
| [#3-001](https://sadjjk.github.io/motion-prompt-zh/#3-001) | **Pan** | Pivot the camera left or right | Slow pan from left to right across the skyline, camera fixed in place, over 5 seconds. |
| [#3-002](https://sadjjk.github.io/motion-prompt-zh/#3-002) | **Tilt** | Pivot the camera up or down | Slow tilt up from the person's feet to the top of the tower. |
| [#3-003](https://sadjjk.github.io/motion-prompt-zh/#3-003) | **Dolly in** | Move the camera toward the subject | Slow dolly in toward her face; move the camera, do not zoom. |
| [#3-004](https://sadjjk.github.io/motion-prompt-zh/#3-004) | **Zoom in** | Magnify with the lens (camera stays put) | The camera stays still; zoom in on the person at the window over 3 seconds. |
| [#3-005](https://sadjjk.github.io/motion-prompt-zh/#3-005) | **Tracking shot** | Move along with the subject | Tracking shot from the side, moving along with the walking person at the same speed. |
| [#3-006](https://sadjjk.github.io/motion-prompt-zh/#3-006) | **Orbit (Arc shot)** | Circle around the subject | Half orbit around the standing person, keeping them in the center of the frame. |
| [#3-007](https://sadjjk.github.io/motion-prompt-zh/#3-007) | **Crane up** | Lift the camera up | Crane up from eye level until the whole town comes into view. |
| [#3-008](https://sadjjk.github.io/motion-prompt-zh/#3-008) | **Dolly zoom (Vertigo)** | Subject stays, background warps | Dolly zoom on his face at the moment he realizes: he stays the same size while the background stretches away. |

#### Shooting style & time · #3 009–016

| # | Name | What it is | How to ask an AI |
|---|---|---|---|
| [#3-009](https://sadjjk.github.io/motion-prompt-zh/#3-009) | **Rack focus** | Shift focus between near and far | Rack focus from the cup in the foreground to the person behind it, in 1 second. |
| [#3-010](https://sadjjk.github.io/motion-prompt-zh/#3-010) | **Handheld** | A slight shake, as if the camera were held by hand | Handheld shot following behind the walking person, with only a slight shake. |
| [#3-011](https://sadjjk.github.io/motion-prompt-zh/#3-011) | **FPV drone shot** | Fast, immersive fly-through | FPV drone shot weaving between the trees and out over the river. |
| [#3-012](https://sadjjk.github.io/motion-prompt-zh/#3-012) | **Dutch angle** | Tilt the frame diagonally | Use a Dutch angle of about 15 degrees for this uneasy scene. |
| [#3-013](https://sadjjk.github.io/motion-prompt-zh/#3-013) | **Slow motion** | Play the action slower | Show the moment of the splash in slow motion. |
| [#3-014](https://sadjjk.github.io/motion-prompt-zh/#3-014) | **Speed ramp** | Change speed mid-shot | Speed ramp: normal speed, slowing at the top of the jump, then back to normal. |
| [#3-015](https://sadjjk.github.io/motion-prompt-zh/#3-015) | **Time-lapse** | Compress hours into seconds | Time-lapse of the city from dusk to night as the lights come on. |
| [#3-016](https://sadjjk.github.io/motion-prompt-zh/#3-016) | **Freeze frame** | Pause the action for a beat | Freeze frame at the moment she turns around; hold for 1 second and show her name. |

#### Cuts & transitions · #3 017–028

| # | Name | What it is | How to ask an AI |
|---|---|---|---|
| [#3-017](https://sadjjk.github.io/motion-prompt-zh/#3-017) | **Jump cut** | Same framing, skip ahead in time | Use jump cuts from the same framing to move quickly through the preparation. |
| [#3-018](https://sadjjk.github.io/motion-prompt-zh/#3-018) | **Match cut** | Cut on a matching shape or motion | Match cut from the round coffee cup to a full moon in the same position. |
| [#3-019](https://sadjjk.github.io/motion-prompt-zh/#3-019) | **Whip pan** | Fast pan blur into the next shot | Whip pan to the right and land in the next location. |
| [#3-020](https://sadjjk.github.io/motion-prompt-zh/#3-020) | **Cross dissolve** | Blend one shot into the next | Cross dissolve from the room in the morning to the same room at night, 1 second. |
| [#3-021](https://sadjjk.github.io/motion-prompt-zh/#3-021) | **Wipe** | A moving edge replaces the shot | Wipe from left to right into the next scene. |
| [#3-022](https://sadjjk.github.io/motion-prompt-zh/#3-022) | **Smash cut** | Abrupt cut to a contrasting scene | Smash cut from the quiet bedroom to a noisy intersection. |
| [#3-023](https://sadjjk.github.io/motion-prompt-zh/#3-023) | **J-cut** | Next scene's audio starts first | J-cut: let the sound of waves from the next scene start before cutting to the sea. |
| [#3-024](https://sadjjk.github.io/motion-prompt-zh/#3-024) | **L-cut** | Previous scene's audio carries over | L-cut: keep her voice going while cutting to the listener's face. |
| [#3-025](https://sadjjk.github.io/motion-prompt-zh/#3-025) | **Establishing shot** | A wide shot that sets up the place and who stands where, before cutting closer | Open with a 2-second establishing shot of two people sitting opposite each other in a café, then cut to a close shot of one of them. |
| [#3-026](https://sadjjk.github.io/motion-prompt-zh/#3-026) | **Shot/reverse shot** | Cutting back and forth between two over-the-shoulder angles of a conversation | Shoot the two-person dialogue as shot/reverse shot, cutting between over-the-shoulder angles every 1.5 seconds, the speaker always facing the camera. |
| [#3-027](https://sadjjk.github.io/motion-prompt-zh/#3-027) | **Match on action** | Cut mid-movement so the action carries on in the next shot | Use a match on action as he pushes open a door: cut to the inside angle halfway through, and the door keeps opening in the next shot. |
| [#3-028](https://sadjjk.github.io/motion-prompt-zh/#3-028) | **180-degree rule** | Keep every camera on one side of the line between two people so left and right never flip | Follow the 180-degree rule for the two-person dialogue: every camera on the same side, the heroine always on the left of the frame. |

#### Storyboards & pacing · #3 085–095

| # | Name | What it is | How to ask an AI |
|---|---|---|---|
| [#3-085](https://sadjjk.github.io/motion-prompt-zh/#3-085) | **Before and after** | Shoot the before and the after from the same spot with the same framing, joined by one action in between | Make a before-and-after of tidying a room: shoot the messy room and the tidy room from the same spot, and have a hand sweep past the lens in between, switching to the tidy room while the hand covers the frame. |
| [#3-086](https://sadjjk.github.io/motion-prompt-zh/#3-086) | **Beat-synced montage** | An edit where every cut lands on the music's beat and the strong beats switch to the most striking shot | Make a beat-synced montage: cut a person walking down the street on every beat, 0.5 s apart; on the strong beats cut to a close-up of the face with a slight zoom pop, and alternate wide and medium shots on the weak beats. |
| [#3-087](https://sadjjk.github.io/motion-prompt-zh/#3-087) | **First and last frame** | Fix the video's first and last frames with two images and describe only the change in between | Generate from a first and last frame: the first frame has her standing on the left, the last has her on the right with a hand raised; the prompt only describes the process: she walks from left to right, stops and raises her hand. |
| [#3-088](https://sadjjk.github.io/motion-prompt-zh/#3-088) | **Action beats** | Break one action into small visible steps and write the speed and pauses of each | Break it into action beats: split "pick up the cup and take a sip" into 5 beats — start, reach slowly, pause for 1 beat, lift quickly, end — and give the speed of each. |
| [#3-089](https://sadjjk.github.io/motion-prompt-zh/#3-089) | **One shot, one action** | Give each shot only one main action and one kind of camera move, and split into more shots when there is more | Rewrite this as one shot, one action: "she walks over, waves and the camera pushes in" becomes 3 shots, each with 1 action and 1 camera setup. |
| [#3-090](https://sadjjk.github.io/motion-prompt-zh/#3-090) | **Three-second hook** | Open on the result, the conflict or a close-up straight away, and tell how it got there afterwards | Open with a three-second hook: the first 3 s are a close-up of the finished cake with a lit candle, then her surprised face, and only then pull back to show the whole room. |
| [#3-091](https://sadjjk.github.io/motion-prompt-zh/#3-091) | **Product three-beat** | A product sequence in three beats: the whole product, a close-up of the selling point, then the product in use | Shoot the thermos as a product three-beat: first a full turn on a turntable to show the whole bottle, then a side-lit close-up of the non-slip ridges on the cap against black, and finally a hand holding it outdoors. |
| [#3-092](https://sadjjk.github.io/motion-prompt-zh/#3-092) | **Shot list script** | A script with one shot per row, listing number, duration, shot size and camera move, picture and sound in a table | Write the morning-café short as a shot list script: 5 shots, each row giving number, duration, shot size and camera move, picture and sound, with neighbouring shots in clearly different sizes. |
| [#3-093](https://sadjjk.github.io/motion-prompt-zh/#3-093) | **Unboxing sequence** | An unboxing in order: the whole box, hands opening it, lifting the product out for the reveal, details, then using it | Make a 5-shot unboxing of the thermos: the box from straight above, hands lifting the lid, the bottle lifted out and held for a beat, a sideways pan across the cap ridges, and finally a person turning it in their hands. |
| [#3-094](https://sadjjk.github.io/motion-prompt-zh/#3-094) | **B-roll over talking head** | Cut to hand shots, object close-ups or scenery that match what is being said, while the voice carries on unbroken | Edit it as B-roll over the talking head: between medium close-ups of the speaker, insert a hand close-up, an overhead desk shot and a city establishing shot, with the voice and subtitles running on without a break. |
| [#3-095](https://sadjjk.github.io/motion-prompt-zh/#3-095) | **15-second ad script** | A 15-second ad laid out as a hook in 0–3 s, 2 selling points in 3–10 s, use in 10–13 s and the product with slogan in the last 2 s | Write a 15-second ad script for the thermos: 0–3 s a drop-proof hook, 3–10 s the non-slip ridges and 12-hour heat retention, 10–13 s carrying it outdoors, and the last 2 s the product with the slogan "hot water, always with you". |

### Shot size & composition

#### Shot size · #3 029–036

| # | Name | What it is | How to ask an AI |
|---|---|---|---|
| [#3-029](https://sadjjk.github.io/motion-prompt-zh/#3-029) | **Extreme long shot** | The person is tiny; the frame is mostly about the place | Extreme long shot of him walking alone through a valley, the figure about a tenth of the frame height, for 4 seconds. |
| [#3-030](https://sadjjk.github.io/motion-prompt-zh/#3-030) | **Full shot** | One person framed from head to toe | Full shot of her taking one big step forward, a little room above the head and below the feet, for 3 seconds. |
| [#3-031](https://sadjjk.github.io/motion-prompt-zh/#3-031) | **Medium long shot** | Framed from the knees up, keeping both movement and expression | Medium long shot of him stepping over a low kerb, the bottom edge of the frame at the knees, for 3 seconds. |
| [#3-032](https://sadjjk.github.io/motion-prompt-zh/#3-032) | **Medium shot** | Framed from the waist up, so hand gestures read clearly | Medium shot of her raising her right hand to wave, the bottom edge of the frame at the waist, for 3 seconds. |
| [#3-033](https://sadjjk.github.io/motion-prompt-zh/#3-033) | **Medium close-up** | Framed from the chest up, centred on speech and expression | Medium close-up of her speaking, the bottom edge of the frame at her chest, for 3 seconds. |
| [#3-034](https://sadjjk.github.io/motion-prompt-zh/#3-034) | **Close-up** | Head and shoulders fill the frame, so small expressions lead | Close-up of him hearing a sound, his eyes flicking and blinking once, framed down to the shoulders, for 3 seconds. |
| [#3-035](https://sadjjk.github.io/motion-prompt-zh/#3-035) | **Extreme close-up** | Only a detail such as the eyes, magnifying the smallest change | Extreme close-up of her eyes, nothing but the eye area, the gaze sweeping to one side and then a blink, for 2 seconds. |
| [#3-036](https://sadjjk.github.io/motion-prompt-zh/#3-036) | **Macro shot** | A very small subject shot so it fills the frame | Macro shot of a tiny fly agaric on moss: the mushroom fills the height of the frame, only a very thin slice at the cap is sharp, the grass in front and behind blurs by its depth, and the camera makes a very slow push-in. Put a water drop and 1 ant on the cap. |

#### Composition · #3 037–043 · 084

| # | Name | What it is | How to ask an AI |
|---|---|---|---|
| [#3-037](https://sadjjk.github.io/motion-prompt-zh/#3-037) | **Rule of thirds** | Put the subject and the horizon near lines that split the frame in thirds | A person on the beach composed by the rule of thirds: the figure on the left third line and the horizon on the lower third. |
| [#3-038](https://sadjjk.github.io/motion-prompt-zh/#3-038) | **Centered composition** | The subject sits dead centre so the eye goes straight to it | Centered composition of a person standing in the middle of an empty square, exactly on the frame's centre line. |
| [#3-039](https://sadjjk.github.io/motion-prompt-zh/#3-039) | **Symmetrical composition** | The two halves of the frame mirror each other across a centre line | Symmetrical composition of a tree-lined avenue, the trees on each side matching, the centre line on the middle of the road. |
| [#3-040](https://sadjjk.github.io/motion-prompt-zh/#3-040) | **Leading lines** | Roads, rails and other lines carry the eye to the subject | Leading-lines composition of railway tracks running into the distance, the two rails converging on a person standing at the end. |
| [#3-041](https://sadjjk.github.io/motion-prompt-zh/#3-041) | **Negative space** | A large plain area around the subject sets it off and carries mood | Negative-space composition of a person standing at the left of a snowfield, the right two thirds of the frame nothing but empty snow. |
| [#3-042](https://sadjjk.github.io/motion-prompt-zh/#3-042) | **Frame within a frame** | A door, window or arch in the foreground frames the subject a second time | Frame-within-a-frame composition of a child in the yard outside, the nearby doorframe enclosing the child in the middle of the picture. |
| [#3-043](https://sadjjk.github.io/motion-prompt-zh/#3-043) | **Foreground, middle ground & background** | Foreground, middle ground and background are laid out in layers for depth | Shoot the person by the lake in three layers: flowers in the foreground, the person in the middle ground, the lake and the woods across it in the background. |
| [#3-084](https://sadjjk.github.io/motion-prompt-zh/#3-084) | **Flat lay** | A composition shot straight down at 90° onto objects laid out flat | Make a breakfast flat lay: shoot a linen cloth from straight above, set down a soy-milk bowl, buns, fried dough sticks, a teacup and chopsticks one by one, keep every dish a perfect circle, chopsticks parallel to the cloth edge, and the bottom right left empty. |

#### Framing & cropping · #3 096–101

| # | Name | What it is | How to ask an AI |
|---|---|---|---|
| [#3-096](https://sadjjk.github.io/motion-prompt-zh/#3-096) | **WeChat article header** | A very wide banner with the subject in the centre so the sides can be cropped, surviving the square crop used when shared | Make a WeChat article header: a 2.35 : 1 banner with the person on the beach right in the middle, so a square crop from the centre still holds the whole person. |
| [#3-097](https://sadjjk.github.io/motion-prompt-zh/#3-097) | **Avatar** | A square that will be cropped to a circle, with the face in the centre and a plain background so it reads even when tiny | Make an avatar: a square with the face dead centre on a plain pale-blue background, still recognisable after a circular crop and shrinking to 16 px. |
| [#3-098](https://sadjjk.github.io/motion-prompt-zh/#3-098) | **Douyin vertical first frame** | In 9:16 the first frame doubles as cover and hook, so the subject goes in the central safe zone and the top, bottom and right are left clear for the interface | Make a Douyin vertical first frame: 9:16, with the person on the beach inside the central safe zone, clear of the right-hand buttons, the caption at the bottom and the top bar. |
| [#3-099](https://sadjjk.github.io/motion-prompt-zh/#3-099) | **Xiaohongshu cover** | A 3:4 portrait cover where the person or object fills over half the frame and space is kept at the top or middle for the title | Make a Xiaohongshu cover: 3:4 portrait, the person on the beach filling about 60% of the height, with a big, short title "Beach weekend" in a band at the top that stays readable when shrunk into the 2-column feed. |
| [#3-100](https://sadjjk.github.io/motion-prompt-zh/#3-100) | **Wallpaper** | A picture sized to the screen ratio, keeping the clock and icon areas quiet and placing the subject where nothing covers it | Make a phone wallpaper: 9:16, with only sky and soft colour up where the clock sits, and the person in front of the hills placed small, below the middle of the screen. |
| [#3-101](https://sadjjk.github.io/motion-prompt-zh/#3-101) | **Livestream background** | A backdrop that leaves the centre for the host and product, keeps the background low-contrast and softly blurred, and puts brand information at shoulder height on both sides | Make a livestream background: a room with bookshelves, a plant and a window, darkened and blurred a step, the centre left free for the host and product, and brand panels at shoulder height on left and right. |

### Light & color

#### Lighting & time of day · #3 044–056

| # | Name | What it is | How to ask an AI |
|---|---|---|---|
| [#3-044](https://sadjjk.github.io/motion-prompt-zh/#3-044) | **Backlighting** | The light source sits behind the subject | Backlit portrait of a person in a meadow, the low sun right behind their head, glowing hair outline and soft haze. |
| [#3-045](https://sadjjk.github.io/motion-prompt-zh/#3-045) | **Rim light** | A light from behind that outlines the subject's edge | Portrait on a black background with rim lights from both rear sides; the face stays dark and only the outline of the head and shoulders glows. |
| [#3-046](https://sadjjk.github.io/motion-prompt-zh/#3-046) | **Silhouette** | The subject shows as a black shape against a bright sky | Silhouette of a person jumping on a beach at sunset; expose for the sky so the person and the palm tree turn pure black. |
| [#3-047](https://sadjjk.github.io/motion-prompt-zh/#3-047) | **Split lighting** | Light from the side splits the face into lit and dark halves | Portrait with split lighting: the light at 90° to the side, the face divided down the nose, the far half in shadow. |
| [#3-048](https://sadjjk.github.io/motion-prompt-zh/#3-048) | **Rembrandt lighting** | High side light that leaves a lit triangle on the shadow cheek | Portrait of an old man in Rembrandt lighting: light from 45° to the side and above, leaving a small triangle of light on the shadow-side cheek. |
| [#3-049](https://sadjjk.github.io/motion-prompt-zh/#3-049) | **Butterfly lighting** | High frontal light that casts a butterfly shadow under the nose | Beauty portrait with butterfly lighting: light straight in front and 45° above, a small butterfly-shaped shadow under the nose. |
| [#3-050](https://sadjjk.github.io/motion-prompt-zh/#3-050) | **Golden hour** | The low, warm light just after sunrise or before sunset | A person in a field at golden hour: the sun near the horizon, long shadows, everything warm orange. |
| [#3-051](https://sadjjk.github.io/motion-prompt-zh/#3-051) | **Blue hour** | The time after sunset or before sunrise when the sky turns deep blue | Harbour city at blue hour: deep blue sky, warm windows and streetlights reflected in the water. |
| [#3-052](https://sadjjk.github.io/motion-prompt-zh/#3-052) | **God rays** | Light becomes visible beams that slant through the scene | Add god rays from the upper left to the portrait: darken the surroundings and let several striped beams of light slant in. |
| [#3-053](https://sadjjk.github.io/motion-prompt-zh/#3-053) | **Window shadow pattern** | Direct sun through a window frame casts a crisp grid of shadows on the person and the wall | Cast a slanted grid of window light and shadow on the person in front of a light wall; as time passes the pattern slides sideways and stretches. |
| [#3-054](https://sadjjk.github.io/motion-prompt-zh/#3-054) | **Follow spotlight** | A hard light from above draws a sharp-edged circle of light on a dark stage | Follow the person walking on stage with a spotlight: everything else pitch dark, only the round pool of light bright, with a visible beam in the haze. |
| [#3-055](https://sadjjk.github.io/motion-prompt-zh/#3-055) | **Dragging the shutter** | The flash freezes the person while the slow shutter drags the background lights into coloured trails | Night party shot with a dragged shutter: the flash freezes the person sharply, the bulbs and windows behind turn into curved coloured trails. |
| [#3-056](https://sadjjk.github.io/motion-prompt-zh/#3-056) | **Under lighting** | Light from below the chin points upwards, the shadows run the wrong way and the face looks eerie | Light the person in a dark room from a torch under the chin: bright at the bottom of the face, darker towards the top, with a big shadow climbing the wall behind. |

#### Light sources & color · #3 057–064

| # | Name | What it is | How to ask an AI |
|---|---|---|---|
| [#3-057](https://sadjjk.github.io/motion-prompt-zh/#3-057) | **Dappled light** | Sunlight through the leaves drops bright patches on the person and the ground | Dappled light on the person standing under a tree: a greenish shade overall, irregular patches of sun on the person and the ground, swaying in the wind. |
| [#3-058](https://sadjjk.github.io/motion-prompt-zh/#3-058) | **Caustics** | Light focused by a rippling surface acting like a lens, casting a moving net of bright curved lines on underwater walls, the floor and skin | Underwater caustics in the pool for a swimmer waving: look up at the surface from below, let slanted beams of light come in, and let a net of bright curved lines drift over the walls, the floor and the skin, without bending the tile lines or the figure. |
| [#3-059](https://sadjjk.github.io/motion-prompt-zh/#3-059) | **Campfire light** | At night only a fire low in front lights the person, warm orange and flickering, with darkness just beyond it | Light the person at a night camp with only the campfire: the side facing the fire flickers orange, the rest falls into darkness, with sparks drifting up. |
| [#3-060](https://sadjjk.github.io/motion-prompt-zh/#3-060) | **Screen glow** | In a dark room only a screen is lit, its cool white light reaching the face and hands from the front | Light the person looking at a laptop at night with only the screen glow: cool white light on the face and chest only, darkness behind. |
| [#3-061](https://sadjjk.github.io/motion-prompt-zh/#3-061) | **Foggy light** | Fog makes the distance paler and whiter, light spreads in the air and the layers recede one by one | Add fog to the evening street: the far hills and buildings fade whiter the further they are, street lamps become big halos in the mist, the person in front stays sharp. |
| [#3-062](https://sadjjk.github.io/motion-prompt-zh/#3-062) | **Moonlight** | Weak, cold blue light comes from high up; shadows are clear but deep and there is little colour | Turn the portrait into a moonlit night: a near-black blue sky, cold light from high up on one side only, and a silver glint on the ground. |
| [#3-063](https://sadjjk.github.io/motion-prompt-zh/#3-063) | **Bicolor lighting** | Two lights of different colours hit from both sides, turning one side of the face magenta and the other cyan | Light the person on a dark background with magenta from the left and cyan from the right, mixing to a pale violet in the middle. |
| [#3-064](https://sadjjk.github.io/motion-prompt-zh/#3-064) | **Color temperature** | Whether light is warm orange or cool blue, measured in kelvin (K) | Sweep the colour temperature of the landscape: from 5500 K to a warm orange 2000 K, then to a cold blue 10000 K and back to 5500 K, with a scale showing the value. |

#### Mood & tone recipes · #3 102–111

| # | Name | What it is | How to ask an AI |
|---|---|---|---|
| [#3-102](https://sadjjk.github.io/motion-prompt-zh/#3-102) | **Cinematic look** | Making a still look like a film frame through a wide aspect, light with a visible source, controlled depth of field and one consistent grade | Give the person by the café window at night a cinematic look: black bars top and bottom, light only from the window on the right, the street lamps behind turned into bokeh, and a teal-and-orange grade overall. |
| [#3-103](https://sadjjk.github.io/motion-prompt-zh/#3-103) | **High-end look** | Looking premium through a restrained palette, generous empty space, soft light and precise material detail | Make the perfume-bottle shot high-end: cut it down to 2–3 muted colours, clear away the flowers and ribbon and place the bottle smaller, add a large soft light from the left, and show the detail of the glass and the metal cap. |
| [#3-104](https://sadjjk.github.io/motion-prompt-zh/#3-104) | **Atmospheric mood** | Giving a picture a mood by working light, haze in the air and colour tone together | Give the person on the forest path some atmosphere: put haze in the air, show beams from the sun behind the trees, keep the whole picture cool with a little warmth only around the sun, and let the shadows around the edges sink. |
| [#3-105](https://sadjjk.github.io/motion-prompt-zh/#3-105) | **Loneliness** | Conveying loneliness by putting a small figure in a big space, leaving the surroundings empty and cold, and lighting only him | Show loneliness with the man on the night platform: pull out to a big wide shot so he is small, let the light of 1 lamp fall on him alone, use blue-grey night colours, and end with the camera backing away very slowly. |
| [#3-106](https://sadjjk.github.io/motion-prompt-zh/#3-106) | **Ambient lighting** | Switching off the main light and keeping only local lights such as LED strips, a desk lamp or a screen, so most of the room is dark and the coloured light has direction | Give the bedroom desk an ambient-light look: switch off the main light so the room goes dark, and keep only a purple-blue LED strip under the ceiling, the warm pool of the desk lamp and the cold blue glow of the monitor. |
| [#3-107](https://sadjjk.github.io/motion-prompt-zh/#3-107) | **Tactile texture** | Showing a surface so you can tell what material it is and how it would feel to the touch | Bring out the texture of the ceramic cup: push in to a close-up, rake a low side light from the left so the grains of the surface show their relief, keep the highlight soft, and add a few fine scratches. |
| [#3-108](https://sadjjk.github.io/motion-prompt-zh/#3-108) | **Dreamy look** | A dream-like look from backlight, highlights that glow softly, blurred flowers or gauze in the foreground and a pink, lavender and cream palette | Make the person among the flowers dreamy: put the sun behind for a glowing rim, let the highlights bloom softly, blur the near flowers into big soft shapes, and shift the colours to pink, lavender and cream. |
| [#3-109](https://sadjjk.github.io/motion-prompt-zh/#3-109) | **Clean look** | A tidy picture with few elements, a background that stays back, and colour and light kept consistent | Make the messy desk clean: clear the clutter and keep only the laptop, cup and plant, take the things off the wall so it brightens, swap the patchy coloured light for even soft light, and pull the colours into one tone. |
| [#3-110](https://sadjjk.github.io/motion-prompt-zh/#3-110) | **Healing vibe** | A calming feel built from warm soft light, a slow pace, small everyday things and empty space | Give the cup of tea by the window a healing vibe: let low warm sunlight slant in, add a casually draped blanket, lower the contrast and add grain, and have the camera push in very slowly. |
| [#3-111](https://sadjjk.github.io/motion-prompt-zh/#3-111) | **Japanese airy look** | An airy look from bright exposure, low contrast, pale colours leaning cyan or warm, and plenty of natural light on everyday scenes | Give the cyclist on the seaside road a Japanese airy look: lift the shadows so nothing is crushed black, backlight the outline so it glows, lean everything slightly towards green-cyan, and lower the contrast so the picture is bright and pale. |

### Lens effects & finishing

#### Lens effects · #3 065–075

| # | Name | What it is | How to ask an AI |
|---|---|---|---|
| [#3-065](https://sadjjk.github.io/motion-prompt-zh/#3-065) | **Bokeh** | Out-of-focus points of light melt into soft discs | Person in a city at night with big round bokeh from the street lights behind; f/1.4, focus on the person. |
| [#3-066](https://sadjjk.github.io/motion-prompt-zh/#3-066) | **Tilt-shift** | Blur top and bottom so a real scene looks like a miniature | High-angle view of a town with a tilt-shift look: a narrow sharp band across the middle, strong blur above and below, boosted colour, like a miniature model. |
| [#3-067](https://sadjjk.github.io/motion-prompt-zh/#3-067) | **Long exposure** | Keep the shutter open long so moving lights become lines | Night road as a long exposure, 8-second shutter: the cars disappear and only their headlights and tail lights remain as white and red trails. |
| [#3-068](https://sadjjk.github.io/motion-prompt-zh/#3-068) | **Panning shot** | Follow a moving subject so only the background streaks | Panning shot of a red car driving past, 1/15 s shutter: the car sharp, the trees and buildings behind streaked sideways. |
| [#3-069](https://sadjjk.github.io/motion-prompt-zh/#3-069) | **Lens flare** | Rings and spots of light from a bright source in the lens | Mountain landscape with the sun in frame and lens flare: coloured ghosts lined up from the sun through the centre to the opposite side. |
| [#3-070](https://sadjjk.github.io/motion-prompt-zh/#3-070) | **Fisheye lens** | Ultra-wide lens that bulges the centre and bends straight lines | City street through a fisheye lens, 180° view, the building edges bowing outward. |
| [#3-071](https://sadjjk.github.io/motion-prompt-zh/#3-071) | **Chromatic aberration** | Red and blue-violet colour fringes along high-contrast edges | Black branches against a white sky with slight chromatic aberration: red and blue-violet fringes on the edges, stronger toward the corners. |
| [#3-072](https://sadjjk.github.io/motion-prompt-zh/#3-072) | **Vignette** | The corners darken and draw the eye to the centre | Beach photo with a strong vignette: the corners darken gradually so the eye goes to the person in the middle. |
| [#3-073](https://sadjjk.github.io/motion-prompt-zh/#3-073) | **Bloom** | Light spills out of the bright areas while the dark areas keep their detail | Add bloom to the night street shot: only the windows, street lamps and car lights glow and spread, the dark buildings stay crisp. |
| [#3-074](https://sadjjk.github.io/motion-prompt-zh/#3-074) | **Soft focus** | Highlights spread softly and contrast drops, while the outlines stay | Soft focus on the landscape portrait: let the bright edges spread gently and lower the contrast a little, but keep the outlines sharp. |
| [#3-075](https://sadjjk.github.io/motion-prompt-zh/#3-075) | **Prism effect** | Rainbow-coloured, offset ghosts appear next to the bright areas | Prism effect on the night street: rainbow ghosts slightly offset next to the window and lamp lights, plus one faint rainbow band across the frame. |

#### Grading & finishing · #3 076–083 · 112

| # | Name | What it is | How to ask an AI |
|---|---|---|---|
| [#3-076](https://sadjjk.github.io/motion-prompt-zh/#3-076) | **High-key** | A bright, white-toned image with very light shadows | High-key still life of a cup and a bottle on a white table: pure white background, very faint shadows, only light tones. |
| [#3-077](https://sadjjk.github.io/motion-prompt-zh/#3-077) | **Low-key** | A dark image where only the lit parts stand out | Low-key shot of a whisky bottle on black, a single side light, only the lit edges showing and most of the frame in deep black. |
| [#3-078](https://sadjjk.github.io/motion-prompt-zh/#3-078) | **Black and white** | Remove colour and show brightness only | Beach snapshot in black and white, contrast slightly raised, keeping the difference in brightness between sky and sand. |
| [#3-079](https://sadjjk.github.io/motion-prompt-zh/#3-079) | **Duotone** | Show the image in two colours, one for darks and one for lights | Portrait photo as a navy-and-pink duotone: darks in navy, lights in pink, nothing else. |
| [#3-080](https://sadjjk.github.io/motion-prompt-zh/#3-080) | **Teal and orange** | Pushes shadows to teal and skin and highlights to orange | Person walking in the city with a cinematic teal and orange grade: shadows and sky toward teal, skin and sunlight toward orange. |
| [#3-081](https://sadjjk.github.io/motion-prompt-zh/#3-081) | **Film grain** | Fine, film-like grain over the image | Add film grain to the beach photo: fine grain all over, blacks slightly lifted and warm. |
| [#3-082](https://sadjjk.github.io/motion-prompt-zh/#3-082) | **Light leak** | Red-orange glow as if light leaked onto the film | Summer memory photo with a light leak coming in from the right edge, red and orange light bleeding in. |
| [#3-083](https://sadjjk.github.io/motion-prompt-zh/#3-083) | **Double exposure** | Two photos layered into one frame | Double exposure of a profile silhouette and a forest-and-mountain landscape on a white background, the landscape visible only inside the head. |
| [#3-112](https://sadjjk.github.io/motion-prompt-zh/#3-112) | **Inpainting brief** | Editing part of an image by stating where to change, what to change it into and that nothing else changes, with the new part lit to match the original | Inpaint this photo: box only the cup in the left hand and repaint it from white porcelain into a red glass cup, with its highlight on the left to match the light source at the top left. Keep the face, pose and background exactly as they are. |

## 4 Visual styles

### Animation styles

#### Flat & line · #4 001–004 · 045–046

| # | Name | What it is | How to ask an AI |
|---|---|---|---|
| [#4-001](https://sadjjk.github.io/motion-prompt-zh/#4-001) | **Flat vector motion** | Flat vector animation: solid colour shapes with no gradients and a bouncy, squash-and-stretch hero | Make a 6-second flat vector clip: a coral dot hops 5 times across a blue sky and cream ground, and flat buildings pop up wherever it lands. |
| [#4-002](https://sadjjk.github.io/motion-prompt-zh/#4-002) | **Line art animation** | Line art animation: one continuous stroke draws itself into a scene and, finally, a logo | Create a line-art animation on midnight blue: one gold stroke draws a horizon, a sprout, buildings and waves in a single line, ending in a ring logo, in about 4 s. |
| [#4-003](https://sadjjk.github.io/motion-prompt-zh/#4-003) | **Morphing** | Morphing style: a single shape keeps transforming into new shapes in time with the beat | Make one shape morph through 8 forms in rhythm — circle, sun, paper plane, heart, star… — with a circular colour wipe behind it at each change, 0.8 s per form. |
| [#4-004](https://sadjjk.github.io/motion-prompt-zh/#4-004) | **Cel animation / line boil** | Hand-drawn cel style: low frame rate and lines that jitter (boil) slightly every frame | Give it a hand-drawn cel look: 12 fps on twos with boiling lines, 3 colours (ink, red, yellow) on cream paper, and a little match-flame character bouncing. |
| [#4-045](https://sadjjk.github.io/motion-prompt-zh/#4-045) | **Ink-circle minimal** | A minimal explainer on warm white paper: one ink circle, a single character inside it and a great deal of empty space | Make a 6-second minimal clip: one brush stroke draws an ink circle, the character 静 fades in inside it, and a short line of small text appears below. |
| [#4-046](https://sadjjk.github.io/motion-prompt-zh/#4-046) | **Keynote number** | A product-launch look: pure black, one thing per screen, and a huge white number that lands the moment it is said | Make a 6-second keynote-style clip: on black, the heading 续航 appears, a big number rolls from 0 to 32 and lands, 小时 follows, and a gradient bar sweeps in underneath. |

#### Space & material · #4 005–008 · 031 · 047–049 · 086

| # | Name | What it is | How to ask an AI |
|---|---|---|---|
| [#4-005](https://sadjjk.github.io/motion-prompt-zh/#4-005) | **Isometric 2.5D** | Isometric 2.5D: a miniature world seen from above at a fixed angle, with no vanishing point | Make an isometric 2.5D city on a floating island: pastel buildings grow one by one every 0.25 s, windows light up and cars drive along the road. |
| [#4-006](https://sadjjk.github.io/motion-prompt-zh/#4-006) | **3D render look** | 3D render look: soft rubbery and glossy objects that bounce with real weight | Make a 3D render-style clip: squishy 3D letters s, o, f, t drop onto a soft pink studio backdrop every 0.5 s and squash and bounce on landing. |
| [#4-007](https://sadjjk.github.io/motion-prompt-zh/#4-007) | **Liquid motion** | Liquid motion: glossy fluid that swells, pinches off, drips and merges back together | Do a liquid-motion piece on dark plum: 6 orange-to-pink-to-purple drops fall from a top band into a pool below and merge, about 3.2 s per drip. |
| [#4-008](https://sadjjk.github.io/motion-prompt-zh/#4-008) | **Aurora gradient & glass** | A soft-glow tech look: half-transparent frosted-glass cards floating over a dark aurora gradient | Give the AI product launch film an aurora-gradient glassmorphism look: 5 aurora-coloured glows drifting slowly over a dark background, with 2 frosted-glass cards floating on top. |
| [#4-031](https://sadjjk.github.io/motion-prompt-zh/#4-031) | **Low poly** | A 3D look built from a few triangles, each painted a single flat shade | Make a low-poly mountain lake: build 3 mountains, the pines on the shore and a raft on the lake out of triangles, and as the light circles once every 6.4 s, let each face step brighter or darker by its facing. |
| [#4-047](https://sadjjk.github.io/motion-prompt-zh/#4-047) | **Starfield spark** | An explainer set in a deep navy starfield where one gold spark is the hero and changes shape as the idea develops | Make a 6-second starfield clip: a gold spark rises, traces a light bulb, then splits into several sparks that join into a constellation. |
| [#4-048](https://sadjjk.github.io/motion-prompt-zh/#4-048) | **Dark gold line art** | An explainer drawn in glowing amber lines on charcoal, building an everyday scene stroke by stroke like a luminous notebook | Make a 6-second dark gold line-art clip with a fixed camera: glowing lines draw a desk, a chair, a person reading and a desk lamp; the lamp switches on, casts a pool of light, and a page turns. |
| [#4-049](https://sadjjk.github.io/motion-prompt-zh/#4-049) | **Clay kawaii** | A cute clay look on a pink cream background: little clay characters with faces squash and bounce as they pop in | Make a 6-second clay kawaii clip: three bean characters line up at a milk-tea stand, and the first one takes a cup and hops for joy. |
| [#4-086](https://sadjjk.github.io/motion-prompt-zh/#4-086) | **Toy bricks** | Plastic bricks with studs drop in one at a time and stack into a model, drawn in orthographic view with a bright top, a pure-colour front and a dark right side | Have toy bricks with studs drop in one at a time and stack up; each should bounce slightly when it lands, and the shadow on the ground should grow as the model gets bigger. |

| [#4-050](https://sadjjk.github.io/motion-prompt-zh/#4-050) | **Magazine editorial** | A magazine feature-page look on warm white paper: hairline masthead rule, big serif headline, two-column body text and a large pull quote | Make a 6-second magazine editorial clip: a feature opener titled 慢生活 builds up rule, headline, body text and pull quote in turn. |
| [#4-051](https://sadjjk.github.io/motion-prompt-zh/#4-051) | **Silent-film title card** | A silent-film look: sepia black-and-white footage with grain, flicker, vertical scratches and frame-rate jitter, cutting between scenes and ornate intertitle cards | Make a 6-second silent-film clip: a train pulls into the station, an intertitle reads 终于到了！, and a passenger steps off. |
| [#4-052](https://sadjjk.github.io/motion-prompt-zh/#4-052) | **RPG dialogue box** | A retro RPG look: a pixel-art scene on top, a navy dialogue window below that types out text letter by letter, and choice menus to move the story on | Make a 6-second RPG dialogue clip: a merchant asks the hero 要买药草吗？, the hero picks 买, and the gold drops by 10. |
| [#4-053](https://sadjjk.github.io/motion-prompt-zh/#4-053) | **Card battle** | A card-game look on green felt: cards flip face up from the deck, then ram, pop damage numbers and drain HP bars to show attack and defence | Make a 6-second card battle clip: two cards hit the table, one attack is blocked with MISS, and the counter-attack deals damage. |
| [#4-065](https://sadjjk.github.io/motion-prompt-zh/#4-065) | **TV news package** | A broadcast-news package look: blue studio, channel bug, LIVE badge, picture-in-picture, two-tier lower third, scrolling ticker and a breaking banner | Make a 6-second TV news clip: the fictional channel 晨光新闻 reports 地铁今起延长运营, with a field picture-in-picture, lower thirds, a scrolling ticker and a breaking banner sweeping across. |
| [#4-066](https://sadjjk.github.io/motion-prompt-zh/#4-066) | **Caption news** | A caption-led social news look: one huge line at a time on a dark screen, keywords blocked in yellow and a number rolling up, readable with the sound off | Make a 6-second caption news clip: a data story 外卖平均 28 分钟送达, with the number rolling from 0 to 28, a yellow block over the keyword and the source sliding in from below. |
| [#4-067](https://sadjjk.github.io/motion-prompt-zh/#4-067) | **Visual investigation** | An investigative-journalism look: source text, scene picture and timeline side by side, linked by highlighter, red circle and timeline cursor, then a push-in and a verdict stamp | Make a 6-second visual investigation clip: dating an old photo — highlight the source text, circle the scene in red, the timeline cursor stops at 1934, then push in and stamp 推定：1934 年. |
| [#4-068](https://sadjjk.github.io/motion-prompt-zh/#4-068) | **Archive light table** | A close-reading archive look: film strips and bamboo slips on a cold white light table, a loupe magnifies one character and a red pen circles it | Make a 6-second archive light table clip: a film strip and bamboo slips are laid on a light table, a loupe runs along the slips, stops on the character 年 and a red pen circles it. |
| [#4-085](https://sadjjk.github.io/motion-prompt-zh/#4-085) | **Rubber-hose cartoon** | A 1930s black-and-white cartoon: a round-bodied character bounces to the beat with arms and legs that bend like rubber hoses, under film grain, flicker and scratches | Make it look like a 1930s black-and-white cartoon: a round character bouncing on the beat, hose-like arms swinging, squashing on each landing, with old film grain and scratches. |
